qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Entrenched Western Canadian gathering and pipeline infrastructure with high proportion of fee-based contracts, but multi-year median GAAP ROIC of 8.0% falls short of the 12% hurdle due to heavy midstream asset capitalization.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (gate_3b = N). Pembina operates essential midstream infrastructure across Western Canada, but its 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 8.0% fails the 12% capital efficiency hurdle. Returns are structurally constrained by heavy capital intensity and negotiated tariff structures.
qualitative.evidence: Pembina provides vital transportation and fractionation services for WCSB hydrocarbons (~3M boe/d capacity). Despite ~85%+ fee-based EBITDA and steady cash generation, capital returns are diluted by heavy fixed asset requirements. GAAP ROIC was 13.3% in FY22 (energy spike), then normalized to 8.4% in FY23, 6.8% in FY24, and 7.6% in FY25, yielding an 8.0% 5-year median.
